title: About me
text:
Hi, my name is Ludo.
I’m in my second year of the Master’s programme Methodology, Statistics and Data Science at Utrecht University. My interest in statistical methods developed during my Bachelor’s in Sociology. My main interest is in Bayesian methods.
I have experience in both research and teaching. I am currently working as a student reasearch-assistant on designing the data-cleaning pipeline for the project Meer Uren Werkt! at the department of Sociology, Utrecht University. Besides, as a student-assistant for the department of Methodology, Statistics & Data Science, Utrecht University, I have taught undergraduate statistics courses. Outside the academic environment, I have taught classes about fake news and financial management at secondary schools throughout the Netherlands.
